Everything about the KLR can be found online... seriously, it went for 2 decades without major change (87~07) and I suspect the 08+ will go a similar length.

The earlier models crash better, but are no fun to ride at 65mph+ for any length of time. They are HEAVY and a challenge to use in any kind of technical off-road riding. But they are also nearly bomb-proof, fix them with duct tape and bailing wire while riding through a dozen 3rd world countries. Also cheap to buy (I bought my '99 in '09 for $900 ~ lots of nines there, lol). IMHO, WAY better bike in Every way than a BMW GS, most importantly in the reliability department (I replaced a GS with the KLR because I was tired of the bike breaking down and stranding me). The #1 fear-mongering issue revolving around KLRs is the "Doohicky". IMHO (certified MC mechanic since 2000), it's WAY over-hyped... it Can be an issue, but doesn't even approach half the bikes out there.. probably closer to 10%. Thankfully, even if you fear, it's a cheap and easy fix.

If you want something more road oriented, go with the single cylinder BMW F650.. want something more dirt oriented, pick anything that's lighter (the Yamaha WR250 can do freeway speeds and is Worlds better off-road).
